zh-CN.title: 聊天外观中心展台
items: 聊天背景和气泡素材现在会自动居中展示，左右相邻选项更便于连续浏览
聊天气泡缩减为单个横向样本，移除了重复的倒影预览

en.title: A centered chat appearance stage
items: Chat backgrounds and bubbles now center automatically, with neighboring options kept within easy reach
Bubble choices now use one compact horizontal sample without the duplicated reflection
